sources.title: DOJ intervened to keep Manafort out of Rikers, report says

reason: Credible report attributes the intervention to a New York Times report; it does not show a public DOJ order.

sources.title: Remarks by President Trump at the Presidential Social Media Summit

supported_event_claim: Trump hosted a White House social-media summit on July 11, 2019.
reason: Official transcript establishes the event and date; the characterization of participants as propaganda pushers is editorial, not a verified fact.

sources.title: Trump ordered hold on military aid days before calling Ukrainian president, officials say

supported_event_claim: Officials reported that Trump ordered a hold on Ukraine military aid in July, before his July 25 call with Zelensky.
reason: Credible contemporaneous reporting supports the hold; it does not establish an instruction to lie to Congress on July 18.

sources.title: Memorandum of Telephone Conversation: President Trump and President Zelensky

supported_event_claim: The official memorandum records the July 25 Trump-Zelensky call, including discussion of investigations and Joe Biden.
reason: Primary government record documents the call; it is a memorandum, not a verbatim transcript, and does not by itself establish a quid pro quo.

sources.title: Trump retweets message claiming antifa is a terrorist organization

sources.title: FBI Statement Regarding Shootings in El Paso and Dayton
